title: Ex-Goldman Analyst's Quant Fund Convicted in China Stock Lending Crackdown
text:
A Shanghai court has handed down criminal sentences to a quantitative fund and several individuals, including a co-founder who previously worked at Goldman Sachs, marking a rare crackdown on a gray-market trading practice in China.
The landmark conviction sends a stark warning to the country’s private funds: ceding trading control can trigger criminal liability.
